card.name: PR Diff & Regression Reviewer
card.description: Audits pull request diffs for behavioral regressions, race conditions, and missing test coverage. Does not push commits or merge branches.

oauth2SecurityScheme.description: OAuth 2.0 bearer token scoped to repository read access.

skills.name: Pull Request Audit
skills.description: Inspects unified diffs and returns line-anchored findings ranked by severity with reproduction notes.
examples: Audit PR #418 for auth boundary regressions and missing edge-case tests
Check this patch for SQL injection or unclosed file descriptors

skills.name: Release Risk Summary
skills.description: Classifies blast radius across touched modules, database migrations, and public API contracts.
examples: Estimate rollout risk for commits main..release/2.4
